claim_note: Level 3 on H6a's ladder for linux/amd64: installed and executed with real dpkg, including maintainer scripts, upgrade and removal. The install used dpkg --instdir into a sandbox rather than modifying the development machine, so the package mechanics are genuine while the prefix is not /usr. No claim is made for any other architecture or Ubuntu release.
depends_note: Computed by dpkg-shlibdeps from the ELF against the system shlibs database, not written by hand. libsqlite3-0 enters only through WebKit for the desktop binary: notriosd and notriosctl link no system SQLite, so the vendored amalgamation provenance is unaffected.
verified: installs with dpkg and runs its maintainer script
CLI runs with no checkout, Go, Node, npm, Wails CLI or compiler present
resolves program assets to the packaged location
creates a library and seeds 15 help notes
service serves the packaged web interface, HTTP 200, on loopback
removal deletes every package file and leaves the library byte-identical
reinstall finds the library intact at schema 27
upgrade 0.7.0-1 to 0.7.0-2 in place, library byte-identical
package contains no user-root paths, so staging created no mutable data
user service unit ships installed and not enabled; postinst makes no enable call
H5 purge works against a packaged install, deleting data and leaving the program
ships a hicolor icon theme in seven sizes, referenced by Icon=notrios in the desktop entry

accepted_gaps.reason: Three man pages are content this project does not have. `notriosctl --help` and the installed /usr/share/notrios/docs cover the same ground, and an internal prerelease is not an archive upload.
Only meaningful for a Debian archive upload, which this is explicitly not.
